sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 'Mahjong at Home: Christmas Edition' is a tile-matching game where you'll use a combination of skill, strategy, and luck to clear the board. The game features a standard Mahjong layout, with 144 tiles arranged in a grid. Your goal is to remove all the tiles by matching pairs of identical tiles, either by matching the tiles themselves or by creating sets and runs.

As you play, you'll encounter a variety of tile types, including suits, honors, and flowers. Each tile type has its own unique characteristics and requirements, which will challenge you to think creatively and strategically. For example, suits can be matched with other suits, while honors can be matched with other honors. Flowers, on the other hand, can be matched with other flowers or with a single suit tile.

One of the key features of 'Mahjong at Home: Christmas Edition' is its dynamic scoring system. Points are awarded for each tile removed from the board, with bonus points awarded for larger sets and runs. The game also features a 'Mahjong Madness' mode, where you'll have to clear the board as quickly as possible to earn bonus points and rewards.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of 'Mahjong at Home: Christmas Edition' are engaging, challenging, and highly addictive. With its unique tile combinations, dynamic scoring system, and exciting gameplay modes, it's a game that will keep you entertained for hours on end.
